name: team-cline
description: The team workflow on ClinePass, Cline's subscription provider (Cline + provider cline-pass, $0 per run): glm-5.3 builds, qwen3.8-max (another vendor) reviews, minimax-m3 plans, same-model rework for 3 rounds, then the fallback dev model kimi-k3 takes the task over on a sibling card (started at once); only when the fallback fails too does the card go to the orchestrator. All four models passed kanban models vet for dev and QA (2026-10-12; none was vetted for plan)

dev.note: Cline on the dev tier's pick (cline-pass/glm-5.3, passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12)

qa.note: qwen3.8-max (passed kanban models vet for QA 2026-10-12): another vendor (qwen) than the glm dev model (zai) and the kimi fallback model (moonshotai)

plan.note: plans run on minimax-m3 in Cline's plan mode (--plan); it passed kanban models vet for dev and QA (2026-10-12), not for plan

fallback.note: fallback dev model (cline-pass/kimi-k3, a third vendor, passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12) on the dev role's agent

candidates.note: in use (passed kanban models vet for dev and QA 2026-10-12, not vetted for plan)

plan.note: Plans run on roles.plan (minimax-m3) in Cline's plan mode (--plan).

fallback.note: Same structure as team-local: after reworkRounds FAILs, a QA stall, an unchanged rework or an unresolved conflict the fallback sibling starts at once (ClinePass runs cost $0). Outages are waited out and then go to the orchestrator: every model is on the same ClinePass subscription, so a fallback can't get around its outage.

senior.note: fallback dev model (passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12): a third vendor (moonshotai), neither the glm dev model nor the qwen QA model, so its sibling is still reviewed by qwen3.8-max. Started without approval (ClinePass runs cost $0); ClinePass notes kimi-k3 will consume usage faster than others. The core never hands a task onto the card's own model and sends a fallback sibling that fails to the orchestrator, so the takeover happens once

tierRules.dev: ClinePass models that passed kanban models vet for dev; $0 per run on the subscription
tierRules.qa: a different vendor than the dev model
tierRules.senior: the fallback dev model: a vendor other than dev and QA

tierNotes.qa: requireDifferentVendor reads the vendor from the id after cline-pass/ (glm → zai, qwen → qwen, kimi → moonshotai, minimax → minimax, mimo → xiaomi, deepseek → deepseek, muse-spark → meta)

settings.why: ClinePass answers need recovery to act: a usage-limit answer is retried and then escalated, an account answer (no subscription, organization account) escalates at once, and an outage is held instead of nudged
recovery must not be switched off for this project
